recognize_zh: 脾臟免疫染色中紅髓充滿大量陽性的中小型淋巴球，呈瀰漫分布，只有少數淡染的區塊（可能是白髓）為陰性，提示紅髓內以某一T細胞族群擴張為主；抗體名稱未標示。
features: Diffuse dense positivity in numerous small to medium lymphoid cells throughout the red pulp
Membranous/cytoplasmic ring-like staining pattern of individual cells
Scattered pale negative zones, likely white pulp or vascular spaces
No discrete positive nodules; distribution is diffuse and interstitial
describe_en: Immunostained splenic section at medium power shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with membranous staining throughout the red pulp, sparing scattered pale zones that likely represent white pulp. The pattern suggests expansion of a T-cell population (e.g., CD3 or CD8), although the antibody is not labeled. In the context of infectious mononucleosis, this would be consistent with the reactive cytotoxic T-cell expansion that infiltrates the red pulp and predisposes to rupture.

ddx.vs: HSTL shows monotonous medium-sized T-cells within sinusoids, typically CD8-negative gamma-delta T-cells with isochromosome 7q, rather than a polymorphous reactive infiltrate.
T-LGL shows a clonal CD8+/CD57+ population with cytopenias and persistent blood lymphocytosis, confirmed by TCR clonality and STAT3 mutation.
